hooks.command: echo '[hookli defaults] pnpm + Turborepo monorepo: packages/hookli (the hookli npm library), packages/hookli-mcp (the hookli-mcp MCP server), apps/docs (Next.js docs on Vercel). Read the workspace CLAUDE.md before editing. Library: one hook per packages/hookli/src/hooks/use-<name>/ folder (use-<name>.ts + vitest tests + index.ts barrel), re-exported from src/hooks/index.ts; every hook has a typed public API, is SSR-safe (guard window/document/navigator/localStorage) and cleans up its effects. Before any commit, run the verify.commands of every area you touched, listed in .claude/workflow.json (library, mcp, docs). `bash ralph/check.sh` is only a partial gate: it skips the mcp checks when the library changed and skips docs check:playgrounds. packages/hookli/hooks.manifest.json is the source of truth; regenerate and commit generated files (scripts/build-mcp-catalog.mjs, scripts/gen-hook-sources.mjs, pnpm --filter hookli run gen:manifest) or CI fails. NEVER `npm publish` / `npm version` / push git tags: releases are a human step.'
